plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official CCA 2025-26 Course Guide (Illustration BFA), storage.googleapis.com/ccaedu-prod. 8-semester recommended path for students matriculating Fall 2025 or Spring 2026. H&S Req.: any 2000-level H&S course* (see notes). H&S Elect.: any 2000- or 3000-level H&S course^ (see notes). "X or Y" boxes encoded as choice slots with code = first-listed option. Placeholder slots use unique synthetic codes for distinct enrollments. First-Year Review (Spring Y1) and Junior Review (Spring Y3) are milestone portfolio reviews, not courses; documented here. Flowchart prerequisite arrows not encoded (attach ambiguously); prereq arrays empty. Direct PDF: https://storage.googleapis.com/ccaedu-prod/media/documents/course_guide_illustration_bfa_2025-26.pdf COORDINATOR FIX 2026-10-02: ILLUS 2200 "Approved Drawing Elective" (sems 3-4) marked choice:true — it is an elective placeholder, consistent with this file's other elective placeholders (FYCST 1000, ILLUS 1000/2000).
